 Dreamstate announces 2026 lineup with over 70 artists 
 Featuring ARTBAT, Above & Beyond, Enrico Sangiuliano, Pegassi, and more.
 Photo credit: Jamal Eid 
 Insomniac has revealed the lineup for the eleventh edition of Dreamstate SoCal , taking place on November 20th and 21st, 2026 , at the Queen Mary Waterfront in Long Beach, California .
 The festival will welcome more than 70 artists across four stages , including the newly redesigned The Void Stage , which will debut at the Long Beach Amphitheater . This year’s edition will also introduce the Beatbox Art Car stage, featuring local trance artists.
 Among the artists making their Dreamstate SoCal debuts are ARTBAT , Enrico Sangiuliano , and Pegassi . The lineup also includes an Anjunabeats Classics set from Above & Beyond .
 Additional performances include Ferry Corsten alongside Marsh , Hannah Laing alongside Marie Vaunt , Alpha 9 alongside Ilan Bluestone , and appearances by Aaron Hibell , JOA , Infected Mushroom , Neelix , Astrix , Vini Vici , BT alongside Matt Fax , Giorgia Angiuli , Mauro Picotto , and Warp Brothers .
 A further highlight is the worldwide debut of Paul van Dyk’s new live concept, ‘The Essence of Acid’ . The performance marks his return to a festival where he appeared during its inaugural edition in 2015.
